title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. Each part is used once as a validation set while the remaining $$7$$ parts form the training set. How many times is each data point used in the training set?

title: Regularization Hyperparameter
text: The regularization hyperparameter is tested across multiple values to find the best fit. If you have $$11$$ different values, how many times will each value be tested during the cross-validation process?

title: Calculating Training Uses
text: Consider that in 8-fold cross-validation, each data point is used in the training set $$7$$ times. How many times will this occur for each of the $$11$$ hyperparameter values?
